68b4b737b3c7a1f57bee8e279500eacaab3b2930.summary: ESET reports that North Korea-aligned ScarCruft (also APT37) trojanized Windows and Android components of a video game platform for Yanbian, China, delivering the Android version of its BirdCall backdoor through trojanized games. The attack was probably ongoing since late 2024. Targets are likely ethnic Koreans in Yanbian, possibly refugees or defectors. BirdCall uses cloud storage drives for command and control and collects files, contacts, SMS, screenshots and voice recordings. The stated goal is espionage.

hedges: ScarCruft is suspected to be a North Korean espionage group.
The attack was probably ongoing since late 2024; the report estimates it happened in late 2024.
The report was unable to determine when the website was first compromised and the supply-chain attack started.
The report believes ScarCruft did not gain access to the game's source code, only to the website or web server.
The report infers the primary targets are ethnic Koreans living in Yanbian, most likely refugees or defectors.
The report thinks ScarCruft skipped the iOS platform, possibly running into Apple's review process.
The report says victims probably installed the trojanized games intentionally.
At the time of writing, the malicious desktop client update package was no longer malicious.
